headline: PALADIN ENERGY STRIKES HIGH-GRADE 'ATLAS' URANIUM 3.5KM FROM TRIPLE R — 4.25% U₃O₈ PEAK, 7 OF 8 HOLES HIT (ASX:PDN)
snippet: Paladin Energy has confirmed a new high-grade uranium discovery at its Patterson Lake South project in Saskatchewan, completing its 2026 winter drilling campaign with seven of eight exploration holes intersecting significant basement-hosted uranium in the new Atlas zone — located 3.5 kilometres south of the world-class Triple R deposit within the Saloon Trend. The standout hole returned 8.0 metres averaging 1.75% U₃O₈, including a 3.0-metre interval grading 4.25% U₃O₈ from 190–193 metres — grades that compare favourably with early discovery intercepts at Triple R. A total of 2,408 metres were drilled across eight holes in the winter program. The Atlas zone remains open along strike and at depth, and all identified Saloon Trend targets are land-based, enabling uninterrupted summer follow-up drilling. For retail uranium investors, Atlas is the single most significant exploration announcement from the Athabasca Basin this week: a new high-grade zone at an already-operating development project, systematically delineated by a disciplined winter campaign, with summer drilling already in motion. Paladin acquired PLS as part of its 2024 takeover of Fission Uranium; the project hosts an advanced NI 43-101 compliant resource and is approaching feasibility stage.

headline: URANIUM ONE MINING ACQUIRES FOGHORN (BC) AND PASFIELD LAKE (SK) URANIUM PROPERTIES — EXPANDS CANADIAN FOOTPRINT (CSE:UUU)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Uranium One Mining Corp. (CSE:UUU)
snippet: Uranium One Mining Corp. (CSE:UUU) announced June 26 that it has entered into a share exchange agreement to acquire two new uranium properties: Foghorn in British Columbia and Pasfield Lake in Saskatchewan. The transaction involves acquiring all issued shares of a private BC holding company, which simultaneously entered into purchase agreements for 100% undivided interests in both projects. Saskatchewan's Pasfield Lake area sits within the broader Athabasca Basin uranium corridor; BC hosts understudied uranium mineralisation alongside critical mineral potential. CEO David Greenway noted the acquisitions 'provide exposure to two prospective exploration districts and further strengthen our pipeline of high-potential uranium assets.' This is the fourth new Canadian uranium exploration program or acquisition announced in the past seven days — underscoring how junior operators are capitalizing on spot prices near $85–$90/lb to accumulate ground ahead of anticipated demand growth. Note for clarity: Uranium One Mining Corp. (CSE:UUU) is a distinct Canadian-listed junior and should not be confused with Uranium One, the Kazakh-Russian entity owned by Rosatom.

headline: ENERGY FUELS TO ACQUIRE VAC FOR $1.9B — MINE-TO-MAGNET RARE EARTH PLATFORM; 400+ PATENTS, 2,000 TPY MAGNETS (TSX:EFR)
snippet: Energy Fuels Inc. (TSX:EFR | NYSE:UUUU) announced June 23 the largest acquisition in its history: a definitive agreement to purchase Vacuumschmelze GmbH & Co. KG (VAC) from Ara Partners for $718 million in cash plus 65.85 million newly issued Energy Fuels shares, implying a total equity value of approximately $1.9 billion. The deal transforms Energy Fuels — currently the only US producer of separated rare earth oxides and operator of the White Mesa Mill in Utah — into a vertically integrated mine-to-magnet platform. VAC, headquartered in Hanau, Germany with facilities in North America, Europe, and Asia, brings more than 100 years of magnetic materials expertise, 400+ patents, 1,000+ customers, and a 2,000 tonne-per-year NdFeB permanent magnet facility in Sumter, South Carolina, scalable to 12,000 tpy. The strategic logic: Energy Fuels supplies uranium and rare earth oxides; starting July 2026, it begins commercial production of separated heavy REEs at White Mesa; VAC converts those oxides into the permanent magnets used in EV motors, wind turbines, and defense systems. Expected to close early 2027 pending foreign investment reviews and antitrust clearance. This is the most significant Western rare earth supply-chain integration deal of 2026, and arguably the most ambitious attempt yet to replicate China's mine-to-magnet model under Western ownership.

headline: WGC SURVEY: RECORD 45% OF CENTRAL BANKERS PLAN TO RAISE GOLD HOLDINGS — STRUCTURAL BID UNDERNEATH THE SPECULATIVE SELLOFF
source_name: Money Metals Exchange / World Gold Council
snippet: The World Gold Council's 2026 Central Bank Gold Reserves Survey — released this week and covered in depth by Money Metals Exchange — found that a record 45% of the 76 surveyed central banks indicated they expected to increase their gold holdings over the next twelve months. The survey result provides important structural context for retail investors trying to make sense of gold's worst week of 2026 — a 5% FOMC-driven correction to near $4,000/oz. Speculative futures traders have been selling aggressively on Fed rate-hike bets, but central banks — who buy physical metal and cannot be shaken out — have continued accumulating at a record pace throughout the correction. The timing is notable: the survey was completed as central banks globally continued to reassess the safety of dollar-denominated reserves, a process accelerated by the 2022 freezing of Russian assets and by the January 2026 milestone when central bank gold holdings surpassed US Treasuries in value at approximately $4 trillion to $3.9 trillion. Money Metals argues this data represents the most reliable forward indicator of structural gold demand — and that the current speculative unwinding is occurring against a backdrop of record institutional physical accumulation, creating a floor that bear-case forecasters have persistently underestimated throughout this bull cycle.

headline: FRANCE COMPLETES GOLD REPATRIATION, INDIA AT 77% — CENTRAL BANK GOLD TOPS US TREASURIES AT $4T FOR THE FIRST TIME
source_name: Discovery Alert / World Gold Council data
snippet: Two of the world's largest gold holders crossed significant repatriation milestones in 2026. France finalized the return of its entire 2,437-tonne gold reserve in January, completing a process begun after 1963 and booking roughly €13 billion in capital gains. The Reserve Bank of India has repatriated approximately 77% of its official gold reserves from overseas storage as of March 2026. The acceleration of repatriation since 2022 is widely attributed to Western governments freezing approximately $300 billion in Russian central bank assets — a decision that prompted every central bank with overseas holdings to recalculate custodial risk. The World Gold Council's 2026 survey found 19% of respondents had increased the share of their gold stored domestically over the past year, up from 7% in 2025. The quantitative result: the value of gold held by central banks crossed $4 trillion in 2026, surpassing US Treasuries at roughly $3.9 trillion — a monetary paradigm shift occurring largely below the radar of Western financial media focused on the FOMC outcome. For junior mining investors, the long-term significance is clear: the world's most conservative, longest-duration institutional buyers are reallocating away from paper toward metal, a structural shift that analysts at Goldman Sachs, UBS, and J.P. Morgan believe has not yet been fully reflected in junior mining equity valuations.

headline: FOUNDERS METALS FINDS NEW 53.1m GOLD ZONE 1.2KM FROM UPPER ANTINO; FROYO ZONE HITS 9.0m AT 12.21 g/t Au (TSXV:FDR)
snippet: Founders Metals Inc. (TSXV:FDR) reported June 23 drill results from two distinct zones at its Antino Gold Project in southeastern Suriname that expand the project's scale in meaningfully different ways. Hole FR217, drilled in a previously untested area 1.2 kilometres west of the well-defined Upper Antino zone, returned 53.1 metres of 1.21 g/t gold from surface — a new discovery in a geologically separate corridor that, if confirmed by follow-up, materially increases the project's footprint. At the Froyo Zone within Upper Antino, hole FR230 returned 9.0 metres of 12.21 g/t gold from 320 metres depth, together with 37.0 metres of 3.27 g/t gold from 209 metres — demonstrating high-grade mineralisation persisting well below existing resource constraints. Five drill rigs are operating continuously on-site. The Antino Gold Project sits in the mineral-rich Guiana Shield, adjacent to the site of Cambior's former Omai mine (approximately 3.7 million ounces produced before 2005 closure). Founders' program represents one of the most active junior gold drilling campaigns in the Americas by metres drilled in 2026, with district-scale discovery potential across a relatively underexplored land package that has now returned significant gold in three distinct zones.

headline: FURY GOLD NINAASKUMUWIN LITHIUM PASSES 6% Li₂O DIRECT SHIPPING TEST — DENSE MEDIA SEPARATION ONLY, 77% RECOVERY (NYSE:FURY)
source_name: GlobeNewswire / Fury Gold Mines Ltd. (NYSE:FURY | TSX:FURY)
snippet: Fury Gold Mines Limited (NYSE:FURY | TSX:FURY) announced June 23 that final metallurgical testing of 85 drill core samples from its Ninaaskumuwin lithium discovery on the Elmer East project in the Eeyou Istchee James Bay Territory, Northern Quebec, has demonstrated a potentially cost-transforming processing pathway. Using dense media separation alone — without the flotation and chemical processing circuits required in conventional spodumene operations — the tests produced a direct shipping ore concentrate grading 6.0% Li₂O with 77% lithium recovery. Direct shipping ore pathways eliminate the capital-intensive processing plants that typically account for 40–60% of lithium project upfront capex, dramatically lowering the threshold for economic development at smaller or more remote deposits. Spodumene is confirmed as the sole lithium-bearing mineral; the pegmatite is free of impurities that typically complicate downstream processing. For retail investors, the practical implication is that Ninaaskumuwin may be economically viable at a lower project scale and capital cost than conventional lithium projects — a particularly meaningful differentiator in the current financing environment. Fury Gold is primarily known as a gold explorer with the Eau Claire project in Quebec; Ninaaskumuwin sits in the same James Bay Lithium Triangle district that hosts Patriot Battery Metals' Corvette and Winsome Resources' Adina.

headline: TROILUS GOLD: 157.5m AT 0.95 g/t AuEq IN Z87 PIT — INFERRED CONVERSION PROGRAM COULD IMPROVE STRIP RATIOS (TSX:TLG)
snippet: Troilus Mining Corp. (TSX:TLG | OTC:CHXMF) reported June 25 results from 13 drill holes totalling 3,718 metres in its Z87 reserve pit optimization program, with the headline interval returning 157.5 metres grading 0.95 g/t gold equivalent within the existing feasibility pit shell. Higher-grade sections included 28 metres at 1.37 g/t AuEq, 30.9 metres at 1.68 g/t AuEq, and 19 metres at 1.16 g/t AuEq. The program targets inferred mineralization and historically unsampled intervals in the hangingwall of the main ore zone — gaps in the geological model that Troilus believes represent an opportunity to improve pit sequencing, reduce strip ratios, and provide higher-grade feed in early mine-life at the planned 50,000 tonne-per-day operation. This is not a greenfield discovery but a systematic mine-plan optimization exercise: converting inferred material to indicated within an already-defined feasibility pit represents de-risking of a known asset rather than exploration upside. Troilus is advancing toward construction financing for one of the largest undeveloped gold deposits in eastern Canada; at gold above $4,000/oz, the project's economics have improved materially from the base-case feasibility assumptions. The project's scale and Québec jurisdiction have made it a recurring subject of analyst M&A commentary.

headline: GOLDMINING INC. $185M IN ASSETS NEARLY EQUALS MARKET CAP; PEA NPVS $532M (SÃO JORGE) + $1B (LA MINA) (NYSE:GLDG)
source_name: PR Newswire / GoldMining Inc. (NYSE American:GLDG | TSX:GLDG)
snippet: GoldMining Inc. (NYSE American:GLDG | TSX:GLDG) issued its mid-year 2026 shareholder update June 26, highlighting a treasury position unusual for a junior gold developer: approximately US$185 million in cash and publicly traded securities — a figure that approaches the company's entire current market capitalisation. Holdings include strategic equity positions in U.S. GoldMining Inc. (Whistler Gold-Copper, Alaska), Gold Royalty Corp., and NevGold Corp. On the project side, GoldMining delivered two Preliminary Economic Assessments in 2026: São Jorge (Brazil) returned an after-tax NPV5% of US$532 million, while La Mina (Colombia) returned an after-tax NPV5% of US$1.0 billion — both at gold price assumptions now well below spot. Three drill rigs are active in Brazil and Colombia, with additional rigs mobilizing in Alaska. U.S. GoldMining's 2026 exploration campaign at Whistler is ahead of schedule with drill pad construction underway at high-priority targets. The structure offers retail investors something rare in the sector: a portfolio of late-stage gold deposits across three jurisdictions, self-funded by treasury, without the concentration risk typical of single-project juniors. The current implied discount to NAV is approaching levels historically associated with re-rating events in the resource sector.

headline: COPPER ONE: FIRST AI-DESIGNED DRILL HOLE UNDERWAY AT MAJUBA HILL PORPHYRY, NEVADA — AHEAD OF JUNE 30 TARIFF DECISION (CSE:CEXY)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Copper One Resources Corp. (CSE:CEXY)
snippet: Copper One Resources Corp. (CSE:CEXY) announced June 26 the commencement of the first diamond drill hole designed by Exploration Technologies Inc. (ExploreTech) using artificial-intelligence-driven subsurface modelling at its Majuba Hill Copper-Silver-Gold Project in Pershing County, Nevada. The 762-metre hole targets a copper-porphyry zone identified through ExploreTech's AI platform, which synthesises historical drilling, geophysics, alteration data, geology, and surface mapping into a subsurface probability model — then generates targets that pure geological interpretation of individual datasets might miss. For the junior mining sector, this represents one of the first live examples of an AI-designed drill hole in a 2026 porphyry copper program, at a time when AI exploration targeting is transitioning from conference presentations to actual ground programs. The commercial timing is notable: the US Department of Commerce Section 232 copper tariff recommendation is due to the White House on June 30, 2026. Under a 30% tariff scenario on refined copper imports, domestically-produced US copper would command a structural pricing premium — directly improving the project economics of any Nevada copper asset at the development stage. Copper One's 2026 program totals 10,000 feet; this first AI-targeted hole is the initial test of the machine-learning model against actual mineralisation.
